run_inception_score: run the inception score evaluation on generated images from an experiment pickle file
run_ground_truth_moments: run inception score on ground truth data to compute reference moments for FID
run_stratified_fid: run stratified FID moment computation for ImageNet-LT validation with few, low, and many splits
review_prepare_parser: review the prepare_parser function that configures CLI arguments for experiment name, batch size, and dataset
review_init_inception: review the _init_inception function that downloads and initializes the TensorFlow Inception v1 graph
